title: Provide new deployed landing page URL and finalize domain-linked public URL

requirements.text: Deploy the latest Smart Salon landing page build (the user-referenced “new version”) to the Internet Computer and provide the new public landing page URL(s) for preview.

quotes: yes & give me my new landing page url as well

acceptanceCriteria: A fresh deployment of the current frontend is published and reachable over HTTPS.
The final public landing page URL(s) are captured as output/artifacts for handoff (at minimum the custom domain URL https://smartsalonapp.com, plus any canister gateway URL if available).
The provided URL(s) open successfully in Chrome without “Error 400 — Canister ID Not Resolved”.

requirements.text: Update frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md so the “Public URLs for Mobile App” section is complete and explicitly lists the final public landing page URL(s), with https://smartsalonapp.com as the Primary URL.

quotes: yes & give me my new landing page url as well

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md includes a filled-in Primary URL set to https://smartsalonapp.com.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md includes any additional relevant URL(s) (e.g., a canister-based URL) if available, clearly labeled and copy-pasteable.
Documentation does not hardcode a canister URL into any user-facing branding/marketing copy; it is only listed as a technical access URL.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Do not change landing page design, copy, or section structure beyond what is required to deploy and to document/provide the new URL(s).
Do not introduce new backend features or data models.
